title: NNDC wallet cards 2023: 222Rn half-life 3.82146 d
summary: The October 2023 wallet-card row for 222Rn prints half-life 3.82146 d (day), uncertainty 16.
body: The October 2023 Nuclear Wallet Cards row for 222Rn prints half-life 3.82146 d (day). The uncertainty integer after the unit is 16. The decay-mode text before the gamma-ray energies is: α. The booklet's half-life note says the value is followed by the unit (s: second, m: minute, h: hour, d: day, y: year) and that the uncertainty follows the unit and is given in italics. Superscripts in powers of ten were read from the smaller glyphs in the PDF. Italics were not a separate character. The uncertainty is the integer in that position. The booklet says all nuclides with T1/2 longer than 1 hour are included. This is an evaluated half-life from that compilation, not a new counting experiment.  The IAEA Live Chart string is on world.physics.222rn-half-life and is not the same printed value. Both are evaluations. This card does not pick a half-life by averaging them and does not convert units.
